reason: It's five minutes from where I already shop on weekends, and I can touch the fabric and have someone check the length on me before I pay, which is exactly why I stopped buying abayas online. If the crepe feels good in my hand I'll likely take one thobe for the wedding season, but I'm not stocking up on the first visit.
objection: Embroidered crepe at $75 can still turn out thin, see-through in daylight, or scratchy at the seams. I need to feel it and see it against the light before I trust a new store, especially one with no track record.
would_change_my_mind: If the fabric feels cheap or sheer when I hold it up, I walk out with nothing, discount or not.
